title: Hosted API enterprise intake: routing & prioritization playbook for chat/streaming/tool-calls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an actionable playbook and automation for triaging hosted-API feature requests from enterprise customers that impact chat, streaming, and tool/function-calling interfaces, with an emphasis on routing to the correct intake path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and producing an objective prioritization score that Sales, Solutions, and Engineering can rely on. The playbook should cover intake form fields, automated tags/labels, scoring rubric, required signal collection (SLO targets, data residency, encryption needs), stakeholder routing rules, and handoffs to PRD creation and evaluation harnesses.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Intake form template (hosted-api-enterprise) created and stored in Confluence with field-level validation for required signals (customer size, latency SLO, regulatory constraints, expected qps, lead revenue)
A2: Linear automation configured: submissions create PM ticket (PM-*) with pre-populated labels and score metadata via webhook
A3: Prioritization rubric defined (weights + thresholds) and validated against 12 historical enterprise requests with retrospective scoring
A4: Routing rules documented that map a scored request to: Hosted roadmap backlog / Dedicated capacity queue / Private deployment request, including escalation paths
A5: Hand-off checklist to ENG and SE includes PRD template link, eval harness template, SLA/security checklist, and expected deliverables
notes: 2026-03-10: Kickoff meeting with Sales Ops, Solutions, and Reliability teams — aligned on core signals: customer size, latency SLO, data residency, regulatory needs, and revenue potential.
2026-03-11: Draft intake form fields created; added conditional questions when 'requires tool-calls' is yes to collect function schemas and third-party integrations.

2026-03-12: Spoke with two enterprise customers (FWD Health, NovaRetail) to validate expected QPS ranges and rollout timelines — both emphasized streaming determinism and audit logging as gating requirements.
2026-03-13: Engineering review (Marco/Leah) suggested adding an 'estimated implementation complexity' band (Low/Medium/High) and a required 'security controls checklist' for Private routing.

2026-03-14: Draft rubric applied to 12 past tickets — results show strong separation for private-triggering signals (data residency, HIPAA/sox), but borderline cases exist for streaming-heavy features — need clearer SLO thresholds.
decisions: D1: Use a quantitative rubric that produces a 0-100 score; thresholds: >=75 -> Private/dedicated review, 50-74 -> Prioritized hosted backlog (fast-track if >$X ARR), <50 -> standard backlog
D2: Weighting for rubric: Security/Compliance 30%, Customer Size/Revenue 25%, Latency/SLO sensitivity 20%, Implementation Complexity 15%, Strategic/Market value 10%
D3: For requests that include tool/function-calls, require a mock function schema and security review before routing to Shared Hosted backlog
D4: Automated tags: chat, streaming, tool-calls, structured-output, enterprise, data-residency (ap-south|eu-west), sla-sensitive
scoring_rubric_example: Score components (0-100): Security/Compliance (0-30), Revenue (0-25), Latency/SLO (0-20), Complexity (0-15), Strategic (0-10)
Example: Customer X (healthcare) -> Security 30, Revenue 18, Latency 12, Complexity 10, Strategic 4 = 74 -> Hosted fast-track with security gating
Example: Customer Y (payment processor) -> Security 30, Revenue 25, Latency 18, Complexity 12, Strategic 8 = 93 -> Escalate to Private/Dedicated pipeline
routing_rules: Private/Dedicated review required when: score >=75 OR explicit regulatory flag (HIPAA, PCI, FedRAMP) OR data_residency requirement incompatible with hosted region
Hosted fast-track (priority lane) when: 50 <= score < 75 AND implementation complexity is Low/Medium AND no regulatory hard-stop
Standard backlog when score < 50 or when business case/revenue is insufficient
Fall-through: if a request includes 'streaming deterministic latency' AND score in 45-80, require Solutions Eng latency feasibility assessment before final routing
intake_form_fields: Customer name, Account owner, ARR/expected revenue, Expected go-live date
Feature summary, Primary model use-case (chat / assistant / embeddings / reranking), Is streaming required? (yes/no)
Does the feature include tool/function-calls? (yes/no). If yes: attach function schemas, examples of calls, expected third-party endpoints
Latency SLO targets (p50/p95/p99), Expected QPS & concurrent sessions, Data residency / regulatory constraints
Security controls required (KMS/HSM, audit logging, retention period), Will customer require on-prem or VPC deployment?
Expected sample prompts and failure mode examples (for eval harness)
handoff_checklist: PRD template link (Confluence) – filled and attached
Eval harness request created (link to shared repo) with representative prompts and metrics
Security checklist completed and security contact assigned
SE & ENG triage meeting scheduled within 5 business days
Initial risk assessment and SLA targets documented
automation_plan: Implement Google Form -> webhook -> Linear PM ticket with prefilled labels and metadata
Lambda function to compute initial prioritization score from form answers and write to Linear custom fields
Notify Solutions Eng Slack channel with score and link to ticket for manual review when score >= 50
Daily digest for PM team of newly submitted enterprise intake requests with >50 score
